content: Hello, I am Lattice Bank's digital assistant. This call is recorded. Am I speaking with Mx Avery Shaw?
Yes, this is Avery Shaw speaking.
First, I need to confirm your identity. What is your postcode?
What is your year of birth?

Thank you. I am calling about overdue payments on your account. Your credit card has 900.00 past due and is 4 days late. Your personal loan has 900.00 past due and is 4 days late. Can you pay the full overdue amount for all of these today?
I can't do that today. I lost my job yesterday, so the salary I'd normally pay from isn't coming. Is there someone in support I could talk to about this?
I am very sorry to hear that. I am connecting you with a colleague now. Thank you for your time. Goodbye.
